title: setRoute is owner-callable with no timelock and no whitelist, allowing instant route swap to a malicious pool that bypasses all on-chain price checks

classification.assetImpact: A malicious or compromised owner can swap the route to a pool they control and drain funds on the next swap, with no on-chain delay for clients to react.

justification: Owner-only attack vector explicitly acknowledged in the contract NatSpec ('Routes are admin-set... must be verified against pool coin indices off-chain'). Centralization tag per project conventions. Recommendation: add a timelock or 2-step route change to give clients reaction time.
